cube: GlobalTravelEngine - Statistics Rate Changes Channel Manager API
label: Channel manager rate changes
purpose: Number of rate changes (rate updates) that hotels push into GlobalTravelEngine through channel managers. Broken down by hotel, contract, API user, channel manager and outcome (correct or error type).
grain: One rate change received through a channel manager API request.
use_for: rate changes or rate updates per day, week or month
rate changes by hotel, city, country or contract
rejected rate changes and their error types
rate changes by channel manager or API user
not_for: number of API calls or response times (Statistics Channel Manager API)
rate or price values (only counts are stored)
price changes found during the booking flow (KPI Change Price)
anything older than about one year

coverage.note: Rolling window of about one year: the oldest day drops off every day (on 2026-10-16 the Calendar started around 2025-10-17), so October 2025 is partial and last-year comparisons are not possible. The oldest day still loaded (about 0.65 million changes) falls in the Calendar's 'Unknown' member: all-time totals and 'Date'[Date] include it, and monthly figures from 'Calendar' do not.

dates.label: Change date
dates.meaning: Day the rate change was received (the cube's main date, with year, quarter, month and week attributes).

dates.label: Change date (plain table)
dates.meaning: The same receipt date in a plain date table with no attributes. It matches 'Calendar'[Date] month by month, except that it also holds the oldest loaded day (October 2025), which 'Calendar' puts in 'Unknown'.

dates.label: Contract start
dates.meaning: Start of the validity period of the contract whose rates changed. This role is new: no shared role fits a contract's validity start.

dates.label: Contract end
dates.meaning: End of the validity period of the contract whose rates changed. This role is new: no shared role fits a contract's validity end.

measures.name: [Changes]
measures.label: Rate changes
measures.definition: Number of rate changes received from hotels through channel managers, accepted and rejected.
measures.notes: Only measure of the cube. 188.9 million all-time, 179.2 million in the last 12 months.

breakdowns.label: Hotel JP code
breakdowns.meaning: Hotel code in the booking engine; the key shared with the hotel statistics cubes.

breakdowns.label: Hotel country
breakdowns.meaning: Country of the hotel. The United Arab Emirates account for about 74% of changes.

breakdowns.label: Contract
breakdowns.meaning: Hotel contract (rate plan) whose rates changed.

breakdowns.label: Contract rate type
breakdowns.meaning: Rate type of the contract. Every change with data is 'Hotelier extranet'.

breakdowns.label: Channel manager
breakdowns.meaning: Channel manager company that sent the change. One company sends about 98% of changes.

breakdowns.label: Integration type
breakdowns.meaning: Integration protocol or connector used. Two types have data; one channel manager's V2 connector carries almost everything.

breakdowns.label: API user
breakdowns.meaning: API login of the hotel or hotel chain that sent the change.

breakdowns.label: Error
breakdowns.meaning: Outcome of the change: 'Correct' (accepted) or the reason it was rejected.
sample_values: Login fails - Invalid user or password

breakdowns.label: Error code
breakdowns.meaning: Technical code of the outcome; 'Correct' means accepted.

breakdowns.label: Week number
breakdowns.meaning: Week number "01" to "53" without the year: always group it with 'Calendar'[Year].

breakdowns.label: Weekday
breakdowns.meaning: Day of the week (Monday to Sunday).

named_filters.name: successful rate changes
named_filters.meaning: Rate changes accepted without an error.

named_filters.name: rate change login errors
named_filters.meaning: Rate changes rejected because the API login or password was invalid.

named_filters.name: uae hotels
named_filters.meaning: Hotels in the United Arab Emirates.

rules: "Rate changes" and "rate updates" mean [Changes] here: the individual changes hotels push. The number of API calls is [Requests] in Statistics Channel Manager API.
These are rate changes pushed by hotels. They are not price changes detected during the booking flow (KPI Change Price).
Rejected changes = [Changes] with Error Type Code other than 'Correct'. Rejection rate = rejected changes ÷ all [Changes] for the same period and breakdown.

About one year of data (rolling window): last-year comparisons are not possible and October 2025 is partial. The Calendar 'Unknown' member holds the oldest loaded day, so leave it out of monthly views.
Only 'Update rates' requests have data, and every contract with data has Rate Type 'Hotelier extranet'.
Hotels match the hotel statistics cubes by JP code and the sales cubes by hotel name only. Expect gaps when comparing with other cubes.

review.question: Does "rate changes" (or "rate updates") mean every change received, or only accepted ones?
review.why: That is what the measure counts and what hotels sent. Accepted or rejected changes are asked for explicitly, using the named filter or the error breakdown.

review.question: Which date should plain questions use: 'Calendar'[Date] or 'Date'[Date]?
review.why: Both are the receipt date and match month by month. 'Calendar' has the month, week and quarter attributes; it misses only the oldest loaded day (about 0.65 million changes).
